name: Healing Word
description: 1st-level evocation, bonus action, range 60 feet. A creature the caster can see regains hit points equal to 1d4 + the caster's spellcasting ability modifier, up to its maximum. No effect on undead or constructs. Costs one 1st-level spell slot.

effects.text: {source.name} calls a word of healing to {target.name}.
